evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids game creation or imposes incompatible constraints on creating games.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with joining via URL and estimator limits; no story prohibits URL-based invites.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates a different input mechanism that would be incompatible; item management stories align with this.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with other stories that list/browse items; no conflicting visibility restriction is stated.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with re-estimation and item list management; no story prevents selecting prior items.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story disallows adding items; aligns with viewing/editing/deleting items.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story states items are immutable; compatible with item lifecycle operations.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires all items to be retained; deletion is not contradicted elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Can coexist with the default behavior of showing all estimates after all have estimated; this story adds an override capability rather than contradicting it.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with also allowing manual entry or auto-fill; multiple ways to finalize an estimate are not inherently inconsistent.

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Does not conflict with accepting average or manual entry; it is a conditional convenience behavior.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry is compatible with other acceptance mechanisms (average/auto-fill).

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with selecting items to re-estimate and viewing prior rounds; no story forbids re-estimation.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with copy/paste as an alternative input method; no exclusivity is stated.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Alternative to importing; not inconsistent with having an import feature.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with viewing/exporting transcripts; deletion of games may reduce what is available but is not a logical inconsistency.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with exporting transcripts and browsing games; no story prohibits transcript viewing.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with CSV export; multiple export formats are not conflicting.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with HTML export; no incompatibility stated.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Does not contradict browsing/viewing/exporting; those apply to games that still exist. No story states games must be retained permanently.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with login, password reminder, and account management; no story forbids accounts.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with account creation and password reminder; no conflicting authentication method is mandated.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: No other story states account details are unchangeable; consistent with account lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Does not conflict with browsing/viewing games; those apply while the account/games exist. No retention requirement elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a fixed timezone display; no inconsistency.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with login/account creation; no story prohibits email-based reminders.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: No other story fixes the card set to a single sequence; consistent with ordering cards across draws.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: No other story specifies a different maximum team size; consistent with inviting/joining by URL.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with moderator inviting via URL and estimator limit; no story requires account login for estimators.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with moderator selecting an item and participants viewing item lists.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with moderator seeing all items; no story restricts this visibility for estimators.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Does not conflict with keeping estimate values hidden until reveal; it only exposes that someone has submitted, not the estimate itself.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Can coexist with a moderator override to reveal early; not inherently incompatible unless stated as mandatory with no exceptions.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Aligned with the more general rule that changes are allowed until draw completion; no contradictory lock rule elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with the requirement to store results in a non-identifiable way; showing per-estimator prior estimates requires linking estimates to a specific estimator identity across time.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with storing results in a non-identifiable way for research purposes; identifying who gave which estimate is incompatible with non-identifiable storage if those results are stored.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes incompatible timer behavior; consistent with timer reset story.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with having a visible two-minute timer; no conflicting reset condition elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with transcripts and re-estimation; deletion stories may remove history but do not contradict the capability when data exists.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with selecting different card sets; ordering can be consistent within the chosen set.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Consistent with PP-034; both allow changes until completion/reveal.

evaluations.evidence: thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits displaying participant identity cues; potential tension with non-identifiable research storage is not explicitly about UI identity display.

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires non-standards-compliant behavior; compatible with browser support and accessibility.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No conflicting requirement about terminology management.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids indexing or imposes incompatible database constraints.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Compatible with standards compliance and accessibility; no story restricts supported browsers to a different set.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates inaccessible behavior; compatible with standards and browser support.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance goal does not contradict other functional stories.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: No other story restricts character sets; compatible with all input/display features.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires opaque or unpredictable URLs; compatible with URL-based invites.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires raw error output; no inconsistency.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Incompatible with stories requiring per-estimator identifiable estimate histories and attribution of estimates to specific people.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics can be aggregated and does not inherently require identifiable storage; no explicit contradiction stated.
